title: Worker failure and queue backlog
summary: An OOM-killed worker shrank the consumer pool below the autoscaler maximum, so queue depth grew faster than it drained and job results were delayed. Restarting the pool restored capacity and drained the backlog.

events.message: Nightly consumer lag report: all queues nominal
Autoscaler declined scale-up: pool already at maximum
Job-status polling degraded: results delayed for some requests
M. Chen confirmed drain rate ~18 msg/s exceeds ingress ~9 msg/s
Backlog fully drained; depth back to baseline
